name: jira-flow-coaching-dashboard
description: This dashboard is designed to help teams visualize their flow metrics, following Yuval Yeret's Flow Coaching methodology. It emphasizes descaling, focusing on flow over utilization, and prioritizing finishing over starting.

author: Yuval Yeret
